message.content: {"claims":[{"quote":"Most shoppers abandon checkout at the card entry form."},{"quote":"Support tickets about failed card entry doubled between March and June."},{"quote":"Competitors let returning shoppers pay in a single tap."},{"quote":"Checkout speed is our top priority."}],"needs":[{"quote":"Shoppers need to pay without retyping their card number on every purchase."},{"quote":"Users need a dashboard."},{"quote":"Finance analysts struggle to reconcile settlements against bank statements."}],"stories":[{"quote":"- As a returning shopper, I want to save my card so that I can check out in one tap."},{"quote":"- As a finance analyst, I want a settlement report so that I can reconcile payouts."}],"dependencies":[{"quote":"Delivery depends on the Fraud team shipping the new risk-scoring API."},{"quote":"The saved-cards launch is blocked until Acme Bank certifies our tokenisation integration."},{"quote":"Once the platform team has finished migrating the ledger to the new database, we can turn on settlement reports."},{"quote":"Per the signed Master Services Agreement with Acme Bank, settlement files must be delivered by 06:00 UTC."},{"quote":"Card data must be stored and processed in line with PCI DSS version 4.0."},{"quote":"Customer data of EU residents must be handled in compliance with GDPR, including the right to erasure."}]}
